answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> False Sects Question ID: 31432 Country: India Title: مرتد Question: I have a friend whose father is a blasphemer (or a "Murtad"). He has written a book against the Prophet(saw)and against Ahle Bait. I have heard from somewhere that he has apologized for that but i am not 100 percent sure. My question is that is it permissible to make friend a person whose father is a Murtad or Shatime Rasul? Answer ID: 31432 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 649/462/L=1432) If your friend is on the right track, there is no harm to befriend with him: ولا تزر وازرۃ وزر اخری۔ الآیۃ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
